jobs.title: Vice President, Registry Operations
jobs.description:
Reliable registry services depend on more than strong processes. They take leaders who bring people, systems and resources together to deliver accurate, accessible service—and who turn improvement opportunities into measurable results. If you bring that combination of operational discipline and customer focus, this is an opportunity to put it to work at ISC.

The Opportunity

As Vice President, Registry Operations, you will lead the efficient, effective and profitable delivery of registries, directories, tax administration and related services on behalf of government and other clients. As a member of ISC’s Senior Leadership Team, you will contribute operational and financial insight to corporate planning and translate approved priorities into practical operating plans, budgets and clear accountabilities.

Your mandate will balance service quality, customer experience, employee engagement and financial performance while meeting legal, regulatory, contractual and information security requirements.

What You’ll Lead

Operational excellence.
Lead day-to-day delivery across complex registry operations, establishing sustainable operating models, shared capabilities and consistent processes that improve accuracy, productivity and service reliability.
Financial performance.
Own operating budgets, forecasts and financial results. Align capacity and spending with service demands, manage costs and variances, safeguard corporate assets and take timely corrective action within delegated authority.
Customer experience and client confidence.
Strengthen service accessibility, turnaround times and responsiveness. Use feedback and complaint trends to resolve recurring issues, maintain effective client relationships and provide clear reporting on service commitments.
Contract governance and risk management.
Ensure delivery meets applicable legislation, regulatory requirements, service level agreements and multi-year Licensing, Service and Operating Agreements. Address disruptions, escalate material risks and follow through on corrective actions.
Continuous improvement.
Turn performance data into practical improvements. Build clear business cases, prioritize approved systems and process changes, and reduce duplication, rework and avoidable costs without compromising quality or compliance.
People leadership.
Coach and develop managers, clarify decision-making authority and establish ownership of service, staffing and budget results. Support employee engagement, positive labour relations and a collaborative, service-focused culture grounded in ISC’s values.
Cross-functional delivery and growth support.
Partner across ISC to align technology, staffing and support services with operational needs. Bring operational expertise to new business and acquisition assessments, and deliver approved integration plans within agreed budgets, timelines and service requirements.
Quality and information security.
Oversee effective quality management and information security systems, including ISO 27001 and other adopted standards, with clear accountability for controls, audit findings and corrective actions.

What You Bring

A post-secondary degree in a relevant discipline and at least 10 years of senior management experience in an organization of comparable size and complexity.
Strong business acumen and experience leading operations, improving customer experience, managing
client relationships and delivering on budgets, forecasts and cost-control commitments.
Senior-level knowledge of service delivery, quality systems, operational controls, capacity planning, service level agreements, project and change management, and continuous improvement.
A record of delivering measurable efficiencies and better customer outcomes while maintaining service continuity, meeting approved budgets and establishing clear accountability for results.
Working knowledge of human resources management, organizational development, employment laws and union labour relations, supported by an ability to coach managers and lead teams through change.
Experience in regulatory or regulated industries, along with the ability to interpret and apply relevant legislation, would be an asset.

What You Bring

You will help strengthen ISC’s reputation as a reliable registry and regulatory operator by delivering on client commitments, making services easier to access and use, and building operations that perform consistently. This role offers the opportunity to contribute at the senior leadership table while staying connected to the people, processes and decisions that shape everyday service.

Help shape how we deliver essential services, strengthen performance and build lasting client confidence. Bring your ideas, lead improvements that matter and help teams succeed in a role where your leadership will make a visible difference. If you’re ready to combine strategic influence with hands-on operational impact, we invite you to explore your next chapter with ISC.

To Apply

For additional information or a confidential discussion, contact Leadership Source at 306-543-1666 or search@leadershipsource.ca. Applications may be submitted confidentially through Leadership Source (https://pod7.app.loxo.co/job/NDM1NjMtZmF0Y3JtN3NhZzdkYjY4Ng==?t=1794850064238).

Early applications are encouraged. The search may advance as strong candidates are identified.

jobs.title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
jobs.description:
Chief Operating Officer (COO)

Who We Are

Great banking should feel effortless. The kind where things just work, the right information is easy to find, and the next step feels natural. At YNCU, we’re focused on making banking simpler, more intuitive, and more useful in the moments that matter. So instead of making people think about how banking works, we make it feel like it just does. That’s one of the ways we show care.
YNCU was created by working people and small business owners who pooled their money to make affordable financial services available to one another. They weren’t just customers—they were our founders. That spirit still shapes how we work today.
Innovation is part of our history, too. Credit unions helped introduce some of Canada’s earliest banking innovations, and that mindset continues at YNCU. We’re always looking for unmet needs, better ways to serve members, and simpler experiences that make banking easier to understand and use.

What You’ll Be Doing

In 2026, YNCU announced a new strategic vision guiding the organization into 2026 and beyond, marking the beginning of its next chapter of growth, clarity, and shared purpose. The strategy sharpens YNCU’s focus on the people who build, protect, and care for communities. This direction builds on the credit union’s recent growth, including the integration of Comtech Fire Credit Union, and reflects YNCU’s commitment to relationship-driven, community-focused banking. As part of this direction, YNCU will deepen member relationships through personalized financial advice, simplify the way members interact with their credit union across digital and in-branch experiences, and tailor products and services to better meet the needs of those who serve others every day.
Consistent with providing Your Neighbourhood Credit Union’s (YNCU) Members with the right financial services to live life, dream big and achieve financial success, the Chief Operating Officer (COO) provides strategic leadership and oversees the organizations operations strategy including retail and commercial delivery, marketing, brand, product, member experience, operational excellence and credit administration.
The COO drives alignment collaboration across YNCU by standardizing sales, service and operational practices, removing barriers to execution, and enabling shared business success. This role accelerates sales performance through strong leadership, coaching and accountability and a culture of continuous improvement as well as operational excellence and regulatory compliance. The COO leads member operations including payments, operations and agent deposit processing.
In addition, the COO will oversee marketing, product and brand strategy across all channels for YNCU to deliver meaningful product and campaign leadership to drive member growth and sustainable business performance.

Leadership and Strategy

Actively and collaboratively participate in YNCU’s strategic planning process with the Chief Leadership Team and the Board of Directors and work closely with peers to develop and implement long and short-term plans to bring the Strategic Plans to life. Be an advocate for internal culture, new initiatives, and transformation.
Provide strategic leadership and guidance to all functional areas of the Credit Union related to operational excellence and member experience.
Provide leadership to assigned Team Members through effective goal setting, delegation, and communication, and drive the achievement of goals in responsible business areas.
Ensure the execution of established goals with Team Members and monitor progress toward and sustainability of achieving set goals.
Conduct performance reviews as required, and formulate and implement corrective actions as needed
Facilitate the design of career development and training plans for each direct report to include coaching, motivation and support

Member Experience

Develop and implement a Member Centric business strategy to deliver outstanding Member experience across the entire Member journey.
Ensure a high quality, service-driven environment through service standards and initiatives that continuously enhance services for Members including the establishment and implementation of measurable performance benchmarks to gauge Member loyalty/satisfaction.
Act as the Chief Complaints Resolution Officer for YNCU and act in any government relations activities on behalf of YNCU and own the Market Code of Conduct.
Champion and evolve the NPS program at YNCU, including target-setting and action planning.
Partner with our marketing team to understand Member insights and research and translate to meaningful strategies to continuously improve the Member experience.
Lead sales enablement: supporting the Chief Member Experience Officer and Chief Commercial Officer and the distribution teams to deliver exceptional advice conversations to members.
Develop and support the frontline in the development of programs that support pipeline management, leveraging YNCU’s investment in Salesforce CRM.

Operational Excellence, Process Improvement & Project Management

Champion procedural enhancements, support systems, resources and activities that are focused on exceptional Member experience.
Provide first-line support to retail branch operations to resolve in-branch issues, business interruptions or management concerns.
Ensure operational policies and procedures and reviewed, modernized and have meaningful job aids and workflows for our staff.
Apply continuous improvement methodologies to YNCU’s operations processes and procedures.
Project management leadership for organizational projects or changes to ensure stakeholder management, resource requirements, timelines and budgets are met.

Marketing

Lead integrated brand and marketing strategy to support growth in membership, deposits, and lending.
Oversee digital marketing, campaign management, content strategy, and market research.
Build strong brand positioning aligned with the credit union’s cooperative mission and community presence.
Drive data-driven marketing and personalized member engagement.

Product Innovation

Work in partnership with retail, commercial and wealth channel leaders to share Member experience feedback and partner on product evolution and innovation to meet Member needs.
Lead business case development and feasibility assessments for new product initiatives.

Operations and Payments

Lead the Member support and payment services team to ensure efficient and timely service to our branch teams.
Accountable for payment processing, investment administration, estate administration and all payment services for YNCU.
Lead the commercial and retail credit administration teams, ensuring timely and accurate support to commercial and retail distribution teams.
Keep abreast of ind
ustry changes as they relate to payments modernization and open banking. Participate and manage any changes to payment products and services driven by industry or third parties.

Other

Actively and collaboratively participate in the annual budget process to ensure alignment of department with YNCU goals and objectives and create effective business plans.
Facilitate risk mitigation and ensure compliance with all regulations pertaining to Member Services.
Stay informed of trends and changes in Member Experience, products and services and provide reports to the Chief Leadership Team. Monitor local, regional and national economic, financial, industry and political events which could impact YNCU.
Prepare reports, participate in meetings, with the Board of Directors and serve on committees as required, and represent and promote YNCU at external functions.
Perform other duties as required.

This position is for an existing vacancy within our team.

What we are looking for:

Post secondary diploma, degree and/or certification in business, finance or a related program, or equivalent business experience
Minimum ten (10) years of senior level experience in financial services predominantly in the areas of financial services operations. Experience with retail branch network.
Strong knowledge of the Credit Unions Act and Regulations, Credit Union By-laws and Policies
Working knowledge of applicable government regulations and legal requirements
Sound knowledge of economic and financial trends
Effective understanding and use of Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
Must have a valid Ontario driver's license and reliable available vehicle
Must meet bonding requirements

The compensation offered to the successful applicant for this role will be determined by the candidate’s relevant skills and experience and internal equity. More information about our total rewards package will be available during the hiring process.

Reports to:
President and Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
Job Type:
Regular Full-Time
Work Location:
Kitchener, ON
This position is eligible for hybrid work arrangement.
We welcome applications from candidates based in the Southern region.

What You’ll Love About Working Here

At YNCU, you are more than an employee. You are part of a purpose driven team that strengthens local communities and champions the credit union difference. We believe banking locally matters, and every day our team helps members build stronger financial futures through personalized advice, trusted relationships, and community support.

As a people first organization, we are committed to an environment where employees feel supported, valued, and empowered to grow. Through professional development, wellness initiatives, volunteering, and collaborative team experiences, we invest in our people because they are at the heart of everything we do. Programs like our Good Neighbours Employee Volunteer Program and Monthly Staff Donation Draws give employees a direct voice in supporting the causes that matter most to them and their communities

When you join our team, you become part of a collaborative culture that values authenticity, growth, and making a meaningful impact in the communities we serve. Some benefits that will support you:

Competitive compensation and incentive programs
100% employer-paid health benefits
Wellness benefits and resources to help you thrive both at work and at home, including mental health support, fitness programs, wellness breaks, and mindfulness resources
7% Matching pension plan

A free banking account and preferred employee rates on lending and investment products

The CFO Centre is actively looking for CFOs in our Halton & Peel region to join our team. You will be a local, or at least an adopted local in the region.

Become Part of Our Dynamic Portfolio CFO Team

Start an amazing new career as a portfolio CFO supporting exciting fast growth businesses. If you’re a top-quality Chief Financial Officer and you’re looking for something different, or you’re an independent CFO who’s already made the break from corporate life, or a working or returning CFO parent who wants more work flexibility and work life balance, then read on, this might be for you

What we do?

We’re looking for top quality CFOs who are looking for a new challenge. Joining the CFO Centre will allow you the opportunity to provide CFO services to ambitious small to mid-size businesses with revenues of $2-$100 million. Our model provides them with a flexible, affordable option to acquire this skill set from a business whose purpose is making a real difference to our worldwide client base. Whether you come from corporate, SME, independent, parent returning to work background – we have opportunities that will allow you to achieve work flexibility and work life balance.

About the CFOC

The CFO Centre Canada has thrived since it was established in 2011, catering to clients across 10 regions nationwide with a powerhouse team of nearly 125+ CFOs, and we're primed for exponential growth in the coming year. The CFO Centre Canada is part of the CFO Centre Group, which began its journey in the UK in 2001.

Today the global CFO Centre Group:

Is the number 1 provider of part-time CFOs
Operates globally from 90+ locations in 18 countries and 5 continents
Has over 750+ colleagues all across the globe, including Canada, UK, USA, Netherlands, Germany, Ireland, Belgium, Italy, Australia, New Zealand, Hong Kong, Singapore,Dubai, India, and South Africa.

What sets us apart?

We define and deliver the numbers that really matter. We help clients identify figures that drive real impact—not just in business, but in their lives. Whether it's fostering growth, facilitating acquisitions, streamlining operations, or enabling desired lifestyles.

What Makes a Successful Portfolio CFO?

Our team consists of highly experienced, like-minded CFOs with hands-on CFO experience. Together we build and nurture a portfolio of diverse clients while you enjoy variety, freedom, and work-life balance.

You can create a successful portfolio CFO career with The CFO Centre if you are energetic, have entrepreneurial drive, and care deeply about helping business leaders thrive.
The life of a portfolio CFO is not just about changing the lives of our clients, it’s about helping you find meaning in your career as well.

You’ll work on a self-employed basis

With the full support from our wider operational team and your fellow CFOs, supporting you to build your portfolio client base.

Access to global support network

You can get the best of both worlds – 750+ global CFOs to support each other. That’s an incredible amount of knowledge and experience to share.

Dedicated regional support team

To work closely with, giving you strategic capability. Building you bespoke campaigns and building your portfolio.

Enjoy comprehensive onboarding, mentoring and a global network of colleagues to share best practices and client experiences.

Do you have experience in some of the following?

Selling/exiting businesses
Identifying risks
Reviewing Business plans
Sourcing funding
Improving systems and controls
Implementing KPI reporting
Increasing profit
Improving cash flow
Tightening up compliance
Optimizing tax and legal
Driving strategic direction of a business
Mergers and acquisitions

The ideal candidate will possess the following:

Be a self-starter with ambition, energy, and a ‘can do’ attitude
Fully engage with our ‘purpose’ of wanting to make a real difference to our clients
Desire to work closely as part of a team together with our Regional Directors in a collegiate environment
Exceptional interpersonal and relationship-building skills
Track record of excellence, achievement, and entrepreneurial drive
Desire to work directly with business owners, with a passion for making a real difference
Well networked
Confidence and gravitas
Excellent presentation skills
Able to develop a strong alignment with the company’s culture
The role is self-employed whilst operating in a defined model. You must be able to support yourself financially during the build-up phase

What do you need to have?

You have worked as a CFO for a minimum of 5+ years during your finance career – commercial and strategic
You are highly networked and love to meet new people, develop business and ensure client satisfaction.

Desired Accreditations

Qualified with one of the major accounting institutes CPA, CA, CMA or equivalent
MBA asset
You are highly networked and love to meet new people, develop business and ensure client satisfaction.

If providing part-time CFO services to ambitious entrepreneurs and their businesses sound exciting to you and if you would like to have the autonomy of growing your own portfolio of clients and be supported by an incredible network-please submit your CV.

*This is a remote based role, but you must be within the region.
*The earnings potential of the CFO role is dependent on the size of the individual’s portfolio of clients

jobs.title: National Accounts Director
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

At OPENLANE we make wholesale easy so our customers can be more successful. 

We’re a technology company
building the world’s most advanced—and uncomplicated—digital marketplace for used vehicles.
We’re a data company
helping customers buy and sell smarter with clear, actionable insights they can understand and use.
And we’re an innovation company
accelerating the future of wholesale remarketing through curiosity, collaboration, and an entrepreneurial spirit.

Our Values: 

Driven Waybuilders.

We pursue challenges that inspire us to build, create, and innovate.
Relentless Curiosity.

We seek to understand and improve our customers’ experience.
Smart Risk-Taking.

We transform risk into progress through data, experience, and intuition.
Fearless Ownership.

We deliver what we promise and learn along the way.

A National Account Director
who will serve as the primary account relationship manager for commercial sellers. The core focus of this role is (1) to retain our high-value client base to increase consignment and sales volume and (2) drive revenue expansion through service penetration.  This will be achieved by demonstrating to the client that OPENLANE is meeting and exceeding the client’s expectations in order to maintain long-term positive partnerships. 

Reporting directly to the Senior Director, Commercial Sales and Strategy, the ideal candidate brings a strong background in relationship management, operational execution, and cross-functional leadership. In this role, they will utilize data-driven insights to guide client decisions and align internal business goals of growing Commercial volume and revenue.   

You Are:

Operational Excellence Champion
:
You translate high-level commercial sales commitments into structured, repeatable account execution plans that deliver on our brand promise.

Solutions-Oriented Problem Solver
:
You thrive on resolving complex corporate client bottlenecks, proactively addressing operational vulnerabilities before they impact customer health.

Collaborative Bridge Builder
:
You naturally unite distributed  Product, Operational, and Regional teams to orchestrate seamless customer workflows.

Data-Informed Delivery Leader
:
You utilize sales and operational metrics, conversion trends, and pipeline volumes to consistently optimize resource allocation and performance tracking.

Influential Matrix Leader
:
You drive organizational alignment and cross-functional project execution through strategic relationship-building and clear communication rather than direct authority.

You Bring:

Core Knowledge

Commercial Account Infrastructure : Deep comprehension of B2B client onboarding processes, service level agreement (SLA) monitoring, and retention management frameworks on a national scale.

Wholesale Lifecycle Dynamics : Solid understanding of the automotive remarketing, vehicle logistics, or wholesale auction ecosystem.

Functional Expertise

Portfolio Solution Delivery : Proven capability executing national or large-scale regional customer success accounts with multiple operational touchpoints.

Cross-Functional Program Influence : Documented success mapping client journeys and establishing unified workflows across Sales, Operations, and Product divisions.

P erformance Metric Architecture : Experience building and managing customer success operational KPIs, delivery dashboards, and performance review cadences.

Technical Expertise

Data Analytics Fluency : Advanced ability to analyze client metrics, including  inventory pipelines, conversion rates, and macro-economic factors to determine client health and provide consultation for our clients. 

Executive Reporting Design : Mastery in translating complex operational performance metrics into concise, professional review decks for corporate clients and internal leaders.

You Own:

Strategic Account Leadership & Client Partnership — 30%

Build genuine relationships with key stakeholders, serving as a trusted advisor dedicated to their long-term success.

Lead strategic planning for existing Commercial accounts, ensuring alignment and partnership between the client and OPENLANE’s goals and objectives.

Ensure that the customer is kept aware of OPENLANE’s strategy and any new components, including acquisitions, products, services, or other updates, as they become available.

Commercial Growth, Solution Selling & Portfolio Expansion — 20%

Identify opportunities for revenue growth, upselling, and cross-selling of services using a solution selling, data-driven approach, including educating the client on all OPENLANE services and products that could benefit their business.

Develop and implement innovative and value-add solutions for customers based on needs analyses.

Identify and pursue opportunities to grow the commercial portfolio.

Keep up to date with market and industry news and trends.

Client Value Delivery, Reporting & Business Reviews — 20%

Forecast and track key account metrics and report on account performance, KPIs, and progress to both clients and internal stakeholders.

Build and report out program reviews for clients and internal staff that demonstrate our value and partnership 

Provide actionable insight based on data and feedback to continuously improve the client experience.

Operational Alignment, SLA Management & Issue Resolution — 10%

Ensure the customer contract is being adhered to and that SLAs are being met.

Communicate across OPENLANE regarding any larger issues that require escalation and assist with the resolution of those issues to the customer’s satisfaction.

Contract, Fee & Volume Ownership — 20%

Own contract and fee management, including negotiation for the assigned client portfolio.

Own volume forecasting for the assigned client portfolio.

Who You Will Work With:

Reporting to the Senior Director, Commercial Sales and Strategy, you will work in close, daily partnership with the national commercial operations team, regional Operations leaders, Finance teams, Product & engineering, and the corporate Marketing division across Canada.

Where You Work:

Your work is performed as a Hybrid or Remote employee, depending on business needs and proximity to corporate regional offices.

Must Have’s:

5+ years of proven success within a corporate commercial environment, with 3+ years explicitly dedicated to managing customer success, operations execution, or enterprise account delivery pipelines.

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, or a verified equivalent level of high-level professional strategic execution experience.

Proven track record supporting major corporate or commercial clients on a national or established regional territory scale.

Demonstrated history of direct accountability for operational delivery tracking, cross-functional project management, and resolving complex corporate account execution bottlenecks.

Nice to Have’s:

Experience operating within the automotive remarketing, wholesale vehicle auction, or industrial fleet logistics sectors.

Direct familiarity with digital marketplace management, e-commerce platforms, or B2B SaaS implementation environments.

What We Offer:

Competitive pay

Medical, dental, and vision benefits with employer HSA contributions (US) and FSA options (US)

Immediately vested 401K (US) or RRSP (Canada) with company match

Paid Vacation, Personal, and Sick Time

Paid maternity and paternity leave (US)

Employer-paid short-term disability, long-term disability, life insurance, and AD&D (US)

Robust Employee Assistance Program

Employer paid Leap into Service Day to volunteer

Tuition Reimbursement for eligible programs

Opportunities to expand your skill set and share your knowledge across a publicly traded, global organization

Company culture of internal promotions, diverse career paths, and meaningful advancement

Sound like a match? Apply Now - We can't wait to hear from you!

Annual Salary: $125,000.00 - $150,000.00 CAD
(Depending on experience, skill set, qualifications, and other relevant factors.)

Target Bonus Range: $0.00 - $45,000.00 CAD Annually

Lead client delivery, customer retention, and overall portfolio performance.

Drive portfolio profitability, resource utilization, and financial performance.
Establish best practices, governance standards, and processes that promote long-term customer success.

7+ years of experience leading ERP implementations, systems integrations, digital transformation, or business process improvement initiatives.

Strong understanding of:

Procore

Exceptional client-facing communication and executive relationship management skills.
Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, Business, Information Systems, or a related field.
MBA or other advanced business education preferred.
Ability to travel up to 25%.

A National Account Director
who will serve as the primary account relationship manager for commercial sellers. The core focus of this role is (1) to retain our high-value client base to increase consignment and sales volume and (2) drive revenue expansion through service penetration.  This will be achieved by demonstrating to the client that OPENLANE is meeting and exceeding the client’s expectations in order to maintain long-term positive partnerships. 

Reporting directly to the Senior Director, Commercial Sales and Strategy, the ideal candidate brings a strong background in relationship management, operational execution, and cross-functional leadership. In this role, they will utilize data-driven insights to guide client decisions and align internal business goals of growing Commercial volume and revenue.   

You Are:

Operational Excellence Champion
:
You translate high-level commercial sales commitments into structured, repeatable account execution plans that deliver on our brand promise.

Solutions-Oriented Problem Solver
:
You thrive on resolving complex corporate client bottlenecks, proactively addressing operational vulnerabilities before they impact customer health.

Collaborative Bridge Builder
:
You naturally unite distributed  Product, Operational, and Regional teams to orchestrate seamless customer workflows.

Data-Informed Delivery Leader
:
You utilize sales and operational metrics, conversion trends, and pipeline volumes to consistently optimize resource allocation and performance tracking.

Influential Matrix Leader
:
You drive organizational alignment and cross-functional project execution through strategic relationship-building and clear communication rather than direct authority.

You Bring:

Core Knowledge

Commercial Account Infrastructure : Deep comprehension of B2B client onboarding processes, service level agreement (SLA) monitoring, and retention management frameworks on a national scale.

Wholesale Lifecycle Dynamics : Solid understanding of the automotive remarketing, vehicle logistics, or wholesale auction ecosystem.

Functional Expertise

Portfolio Solution Delivery : Proven capability executing national or large-scale regional customer success accounts with multiple operational touchpoints.

Cross-Functional Program Influence : Documented success mapping client journeys and establishing unified workflows across Sales, Operations, and Product divisions.

P erformance Metric Architecture : Experience building and managing customer success operational KPIs, delivery dashboards, and performance review cadences.

Technical Expertise

Data Analytics Fluency : Advanced ability to analyze client metrics, including  inventory pipelines, conversion rates, and macro-economic factors to determine client health and provide consultation for our clients. 

Executive Reporting Design : Mastery in translating complex operational performance metrics into concise, professional review decks for corporate clients and internal leaders.

You Own:

Strategic Account Leadership & Client Partnership — 30%

Build genuine relationships with key stakeholders, serving as a trusted advisor dedicated to their long-term success.

Lead strategic planning for existing Commercial accounts, ensuring alignment and partnership between the client and OPENLANE’s goals and objectives.

Ensure that the customer is kept aware of OPENLANE’s strategy and any new components, including acquisitions, products, services, or other updates, as they become available.

Commercial Growth, Solution Selling & Portfolio Expansion — 20%

Identify opportunities for revenue growth, upselling, and cross-selling of services using a solution selling, data-driven approach, including educating the client on all OPENLANE services and products that could benefit their business.

Develop and implement innovative and value-add solutions for customers based on needs analyses.

Identify and pursue opportunities to grow the commercial portfolio.

Keep up to date with market and industry news and trends.

Client Value Delivery, Reporting & Business Reviews — 20%

Forecast and track key account metrics and report on account performance, KPIs, and progress to both clients and internal stakeholders.

Build and report out program reviews for clients and internal staff that demonstrate our value and partnership 

Provide actionable insight based on data and feedback to continuously improve the client experience.

Operational Alignment, SLA Management & Issue Resolution — 10%

Ensure the customer contract is being adhered to and that SLAs are being met.

Communicate across OPENLANE regarding any larger issues that require escalation and assist with the resolution of those issues to the customer’s satisfaction.

Contract, Fee & Volume Ownership — 20%

Own contract and fee management, including negotiation for the assigned client portfolio.

Own volume forecasting for the assigned client portfolio.
